entities.summary: Charlotte Sound, a notable figure in the history of New Zealand, associated with European Exploration of New Zealand (1769–1777). Preceded by James Cook's Voyages to New Zealand and Abel Tasman's Encounter. Their legacy influenced Musket Wars.
